Higgsfield Black Friday 2026: what you save per second

Edited by Emmanuel Gonzalez

Some links on this page are affiliate links. Affiliate disclosure.

Higgsfield has not posted a Black Friday 2026 sale on its own site. The offer on the pricing page today is the 11.11 sale, which the page says ends on Nov 15. This page converts those checkout prices into dollars per second of finished video, next to the cheapest alternatives already in the price catalog.

Last checked 2026-11-12.

Checked 2026-11-12 on the Higgsfield pricing page and the official 11.11 deals post. Prices exclude VAT and local taxes, which are added at checkout. Always confirm the price on Higgsfield's page before you buy.

What is confirmed, and what is not

Confirmed: no Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or Cyber Week 2026 label appears on the pricing page or that 11.11 post. A live 11.11 sale is listed, with the plan prices below. The page does not say the sale is for new users only. Unlimited Seedance 2.5 and some image models are included for a limited number of days on Plus and Ultra, only on higgsfield.ai.

Not announced: a Black Friday 2026 discount, its dates, or its fine print. Unknown: whether the listed annual prices revert after Nov 15, the dollar price of the $0 three-day MCP trial's automatic Ultra 3K renewal (the blog only says "a discounted price"), and Higgsfield's Seedance 2.5 credits per clip. Those last two are not turned into dollars per second here.

11.11 checkout prices

The banner "up to 60% off" is measured against Higgsfield's own list prices and is the labeled cut on Ultra 9K annual, not on every card. Starter stays $19/mo, monthly or annual, with no 11.11 cut.

  • Plus annual: $59/mo list to $35/mo, billed yearly, labeled 41% off, 1,200 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Plus monthly, first month: $59/mo list to $47 the first month, then $59/mo, labeled 20% off, 1,200 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Ultra 3K annual: $129/mo list to $65/mo, billed yearly, labeled 50% off, 3,000 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Ultra 3K monthly, first month: $129/mo list to $79 the first month, then $129/mo, labeled 40% off, 3,000 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Ultra 6K annual: $258/mo list to $110/mo, billed yearly, labeled 57% off, 6,000 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Ultra 6K monthly, first month: $250/mo list to $150 the first month, then $250/mo, labeled 40% off, 6,000 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Ultra 9K annual: $387/mo list to $150/mo, billed yearly, labeled 60% off, 9,000 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.
  • Ultra 9K monthly, first month: $375/mo list to $209 the first month, then $375/mo, labeled 45% off, 9,000 credits / month. Checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.

Higgsfield's help article How do promo prices work? says a promo price applies to the first payment or the period stated in the offer, and that the subscription then renews at the standard plan price. Monthly Plus and Ultra first-month cards already state the renewal list price. Annual cards do not say what happens to the listed $35 and $65 prices after Nov 15.

Unlimited Seedance 2.5 during the 11.11 sale, from the deal record (checked 2026-11-12, Higgsfield pricing page): Plus annual: 14 days, up to 30s, 720p; Ultra annual: 14 days, up to 30s, 1080p; Plus monthly: 7 days, up to 20s, 480p; Ultra monthly: 14 days, up to 20s, 720p. Those windows are web-only on higgsfield.ai, not on MCP, CLI, Canvas, or Supercomputer, and speed may change when traffic is high. They are not a dollars-per-second rate. See unlimited Seedance 2.5 plans compared.

What you actually save per second

The formula is the same one the rest of VidFare uses for credit plans: plan dollars per month, divided by credits per month, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in the clip, assuming every paid credit is used. Wan 3.0 and Wan 3.0 Prime credit rates on the pricing-page compare table have no tilde. Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, and Hailuo 2.3 are marked approximate on that table, so those rows are estimates. VidFare's Kling 3.0 catalog rows use 7.5 credits per 5 seconds at 720p and 8.75 at 1080p, from Higgsfield's yearly clip counts, not the "~7" / "~8" shorthand.

Regular in this table is the monthly list price (Plus $59, Ultra 3K $129). Sale annual is the 11.11 annual checkout. Figures are from the price catalog, last checked 2026-11-12. Higgsfield pricing page.

On Ultra 9K annual at $150/mo for 9,000 credits, the same 5-second 480p Wan 3.0 Prime clip is $0.025/s. That figure is computed from the deal price and the catalog credit rate; it is not a row in the price catalog yet. Ultra 6K annual at $110/mo for 6,000 credits is $0.0275/s for that clip.

A first-month monthly price looks cheaper in that first month and much closer to the regular monthly rate over 12 months. For Plus, $47 the first month and $59 for the next 11 months is $58 a month on average. That blend is illustrative; Higgsfield does not print it.

What to recheck

After Nov 15 (the sale countdown reaches zero at Nov 14, 4:00 PM PT): whether the annual list prices stay at $35 and $65, and whether the unlimited windows are gone. On or after Nov 27: whether Higgsfield has posted a Black Friday 2026 offer on its own pricing page or blog. This page does not invent that offer.

FAQ

Has Higgsfield announced a Black Friday 2026 sale?

Not as of 2026-11-12. The pricing page and the official 11.11 deals post list an 11.11 sale, not a Black Friday, Cyber Monday, or Cyber Week offer. Black Friday 2026 is November 27. This page will need a recheck then.

When does the 11.11 sale end?

The pricing page says the 11.11 sale ends on Nov 15. The public sale record the page loads ends at 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z, which is November 14, 4:00 PM PT. The official blog says plans must be purchased by November 14 at 23:59 UTC, one minute earlier. Plus and Ultra monthly first-month prices are labeled as a first payment that then renews at the monthly list. It is not confirmed whether the listed annual prices stay the same after the sale ends.

How is dollars per second calculated?

A credit-plan rate is plan price divided by monthly credits, times credits per clip, divided by seconds in that clip. That math assumes every paid credit is used. A figure the vendor marks with a tilde, or that VidFare already stores as an estimate, is labeled an estimate. Seedance 2.5 has no Higgsfield plan credit rate in the catalog, so it has no plan dollars-per-second here.

Is the 'up to 60% off' badge the saving on every plan?

No. On the annual tab, 60% off is the labeled cut on Ultra 9K annual. Ultra 3K annual is labeled 50% off, Plus annual 41% off. A 60% chip sits next to the 3K/6K/9K selector even when a lower tier is selected. The card's own percent is the checkout math. Business plans are billed separately as up to 63% off.
